latest.title: Warnings for unmet staff demands
latest.summary: Needs attention now tells you when your employees' demands are not met, at every kind of site: the schedule they asked for, equipment at their desk, a water cooler or fridge in the building, a clean workplace. Each site gets one line naming what is missing and for how many staff, and health insurance and a happy boss go on one company line. The line turns critical once someone with an unmet demand has warned they will quit, and a site's page lists the demands under its crew.
